picks.creator: Dennis
picks.title: H&M X SNOOPY – the mall window surprise
picks.why: 45× this account's usual video. On-screen text "H&M X SNOOPY" + a shocked face sells it as a famous-brand collab in the first second.
picks.how: 0–2 s: a girl with a drink in a mall stops, shocked, and points. 2–3 s: quick pan to a shop window where mannequins wear our robe. Then straight into the robe try-on. Text: "H&M X SNOOPY" (or Target / Costco). Works for both robes: "H&M X PRINCESS".

picks.creator: Dennis
picks.title: "Do not let a Snoopy mom see this" – satisfying flat-lay
picks.why: 40× the account's usual video. Calm ASMR close-ups of the robe laid flat (gloved hands brushing the fabric) make people watch to the end.
picks.how: Robe laid flat on a clean floor, top-down camera. Black-gloved hands smooth and brush the fabric, show the hood, fold a sleeve. Slow, satisfying, 6–8 s, then the try-on. Text: "Do NOT let a Snoopy mom see this…".

picks.creator: Dennis
picks.title: "I made this for cold American winters" – the cake-tray reveal
picks.why: The most-viewed Instagram video of the scan. A rolled robe looks like a cake; lifting the baking tray off it is the surprise.
picks.how: Top-down: the rolled robe on a tray like a cake, a hand lifts the baking tray / cuts with a spatula, the robe pattern shows. Cut to her wearing it, opening it wide. Text: "I made this for cold American winters 🥶🇺🇸".

picks.creator: Abed
picks.title: Costco X Snoopy – store staff with a pallet of boxes
picks.why: 14× the account's usual video. Two store workers in red vests dancing next to a full pallet of our boxes reads like a real store launch.
picks.how: Wide shot in a warehouse store: two employees in red vests stand by a pallet stacked with our boxes, wave and dance for 3–4 s. Cut to the robe at home. Text: "Costco X Snoopy 🤩". For Princess: our royal-blue Princess boxes.
